reading_note: The teaching describes the descent of Divine Truth (Jesus the Son) from the inmost Divine (the Greatness) into the natural world through ten successive vehicles of accommodation. Each "chariot" or "mount" is a discrete degree of clothing by which the Divine adapts itself to lower receptive states: beginning with the pure vessel of light, passing through the form of the First Man and the Pillar of ascent, then putting on the Call and Answer (the awakening of truth and its responsive affection), then the living Air, Wind, Light, Water, and Fire — the five elementals of spiritual life that pervade every degree. The single arc: how the inmost Divine Good clothes itself in successively more external forms of truth in order to be present in every degree of heaven and the world, above and below.
